name: For Further Study
label: Quest
description: Historian Karnik is waiting in Ironforge for a package tied to something epic. What has been seen so far makes further study seem worthwhile.
intro: Historian Karnik is waiting in Ironforge for a package tied to something epic. What has been seen so far makes further study seem worthwhile.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Whatever this is all about, friend, it's epic stuff alright.
I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.
It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
